title: Full Moon Yoga in Backyard
description: We will Celebrate the full moon on October 22nd. Bring water, mat and towel. Arrive early and shop! Always a special for Yogis on Full Moon night! Any Purchase in the Shop, and Maddie will discount next month's Yoga!   $15pp For more info Follow @maddieplocklear

title: Mahjong -Guided Play
description:
This game night is for people who already know  how to play Mahjong. Attend to level up and learn tips and strategic hands to play.  Game sets provided. Bring your Mahjong card. $25 pp.  Drink specials available.
Watch for intro class for new players coming in January

title: Silk Scarf Custom Dying
description: Back by popular demand, learn the delicate art of naturally dying and designing your own silk scarf.  Class includes all materials and instruction by Shalini, a well known silk artist. $$60pp. makes a great gift!

title: New Moon Monday Tarot for Beginners
description: Tarot for Beginners is a guided course through the history, meanings, & patterns of tarot cards. Please bring a tarot deck if you have one! Whether you’re already learning or just curious, this class will give you the tools to begin your own path! $45pp. Class is space limited, advance pay required.

title: Sourdough Starter Workshop
description: Create your own sourdough starter while learning the basics of sourdough baking in this beginner-friendly, hands-on workshop. You’ll build a sourdough starter from scratch, explore the basics of fermentation, and create your own sourdough loaf to bake at home. $40

title: Holiday Ornaments Pottery
description: Join Aramore Arts for Holiday ornament making $65pp

title: Italian Sandal Making Experience
description:
The LILI by Zuania Sandal-Making
Discover the art of handmade Italian leather sandals with LILI by Zuania! Enjoy a unique, hands-on experience where you choose your favorite style and Italian leather colors, learn the art of sandal making, and create your own bespoke pair. $250 pp

title: Live on Lang: Sofar Sounds Orlando
description: Join us in the backyard for a night of intimate live music curated by Sofar Sounds Orlando.

title: Introduction to Mahjong
description: Join Toby  & Cindy for an intro to Mahjong.  This workshop is a two class commitment to gain the knowledge to play in your own group.  All materials provided including the 2026 Mahjong Card.  $100 pp for two classes. 1/13 & 1/20 Class is limited to 12 people.
